title: Offline Pi context-length, compaction-quality, retry, and cost sensitivity study
objective: Compare long-session context policies under a deterministic Pi-to-GitHub-Copilot cost ledger and an explicitly hypothetical context-quality mechanism, then locate the assumptions under which one strategy becomes preferable to another.

executionPolicy.monteCarloPurpose: validate analytic retry and ratio calculations only

excludedClaims: observed GPT-5.6 quality or context rot
observed Pi or Copilot retry rate
causal effect of context length in production
actual cache eligibility or third-party 800K availability

sessionDesign.conditionalAvailability: The 800000-token Pi path is theoretical. Pi catalogs a 1050000-token window, but GitHub's public one-million-token client guarantee names supported Copilot clients rather than third-party Pi.

primaryContrast.direction: comparison minus baseline for completion and cost per successful session; baseline minus comparison for provider savings
primaryContrast.interpretation: Conditional cost-quality tradeoff, not an empirical policy recommendation

deterministicCostLayer.source: validated outputs of the offline pi-cost-elasticity study
deterministicCostLayer.requestAccounting: For every request, total input equals mutually exclusive uncached input plus cache-read plus cache-write tokens; output is separate.
deterministicCostLayer.tierRule: All token categories in a request use the long-context rates only when total request input is strictly greater than the model-specific GitHub Copilot threshold.
deterministicCostLayer.retryAttemptCostRule: A retry repeats the same complete strategy trajectory and therefore has the same deterministic provider cost as the first attempt.
deterministicCostLayer.cashBoundary: Values are provider token value before included GitHub AI Credits, subscription allocation, or overage state.

contextExposure.name: normalized_excess_auc
contextExposure.activePromptRule: Use the active main-request input after any compaction, not the discarded logical history.
contextExposure.fixedUnitRationale: The fixed 100000-token denominator keeps beta comparable across onset values and compatible with the historical two-anchor logit slopes.

effectiveEvidenceFidelity.compactionCountForEvidenceAtCall: c_i = count(j in compactionLogicalPositions where j >= i)
effectiveEvidenceFidelity.boundary: F = 1 for an uncompacted trajectory or when perCompactionFidelity = 1
effectiveEvidenceFidelity.semanticMeaning: Retained task-relevant information, not token compression ratio

singleAttemptProbability.betaUnit: log-odds decrease per mean excess 100000-token-call unit

qualityLayer.aggregationRule: Compute quality, completion, attempts, and assigned cost within each stratum; then weight the stratum quantities. Never apply the nonlinear retry formula only to the weighted p0.

retryLayer.mechanism: Independent identically distributed attempts conditional on task stratum and strategy
retryLayer.failureDependenceCaveat: Repeated attempts may fail for the same missing evidence or bad summary in reality; correlated retries are a required challenge case outside the primary analytic mechanism.

design.canonicalUnit: strategy x parameter_set x model x task_stratum, with stochastic tasks used only for selected Monte Carlo sentinels

evidencePolicy.eligibleInterpolationAnchor: Finite positive context_tokens and proportion score, plus either (a) evidence_status = source-reported with numeric_precision in {exact, rounded}, or (b) evidence_status = independently-derived with numeric_precision = exact and an explicitly approved immutable digest-pinned row-level source. The approved derived series is chroma-gpt41-longmemeval-reanalysis.
evidencePolicy.ineligibleRowsRemainVisible: Approximate, inequality, count, p_value, tokenless, non-context, and non-approved independently derived statistics remain in the evidence inventory but cannot silently become interpolation anchors.
evidencePolicy.referenceRule: Within each series, divide score by the earliest eligible context anchor score.
evidencePolicy.crossingRule: Use the first adjacent downward crossing with r0 >= target and r1 < target.
evidencePolicy.transferRule: No evidence series is a GPT-5.6 or Pi calibration unless collected on the target model, harness, task mix, and protocol.

monteCarloValidation.role: numerical validation of exact analytic expectations
monteCarloValidation.taskStratumDraw: one common uniform mapped to easy below 0.25, typical below 0.75, and hard otherwise
monteCarloValidation.attemptDraws: one common uniform per allowed attempt
monteCarloValidation.completionMcse: paired sample standard deviation of comparison-minus-baseline completion divided by sqrt(task_count)
monteCarloValidation.costPerSuccessMcse: paired delta-method influence-function standard error for the difference of cost-to-success ratios
monteCarloValidation.acceptance: The analytic completion delta and analytic cost-per-success delta must each lie inside the corresponding fixed-seed Monte Carlo 95 percent interval.

breakEven.providerSavingsFormula: baseline provider cost per assigned session - comparison provider cost per assigned session
breakEven.completionLossFormula: max(baseline completion probability - comparison completion probability, 0)
breakEven.failureLossThresholdFormula: provider savings per assigned session / completion probability loss
breakEven.identifiedStatus: identified_tradeoff when savings and completion loss are both positive
breakEven.meaning: When identified, compaction is economically preferred only if one additional unresolved session is valued below the threshold, conditional on all model assumptions.

targets: minimum fidelity with compact cost per successful session not above grow
minimum fidelity with compact completion probability at least 0.95

betaSearch.target: minimum beta with compact cost per successful session not above grow

assumptions.statement: Mean excess context changes log-odds linearly through beta after onset.
The 25/50/25 easy/typical/hard mixture and its p0 values represent the hypothetical workload.
assumptions.challenge: report strata separately and change mixture weights

assumptions.statement: Each compaction independently retains a constant fraction of relevant evidence and losses multiply.
assumptions.challenge: lossless, severe-loss, correlated-loss, and evidence-position profiles

assumptions.statement: Retries are independent conditional on task stratum and strategy and repeat the same full provider-cost trajectory.
assumptions.challenge: perfectly correlated failures and changed retry prompts or cache state

assumptions.statement: The validated deterministic cost bundle correctly represents provider token value for each selected strategy.
assumptions.challenge: compaction cache modes and model-specific pricing caps

assumptions.statement: Historical benchmark slopes are useful stress profiles but do not estimate GPT-5.6 Pi-session behavior.
The theoretical 800K route is available and behaves as represented by the cost ledger.
assumptions.challenge: report cap policies without claiming third-party service support

validationRequirements: All cost trajectories are imported from a passing independently validated deterministic cost bundle.
The grow trajectory has exactly 39 main prompts from 40000 through 800000 in 20000-token increments.
The cap-200K trajectory has exactly 39 main prompts and compactions at logical positions 9, 18, 27, and 36.
At onset 200000, grow normalized excess AUC equals 31/13 and cap-200K normalized excess AUC equals zero.
At fidelity 0.95 with uniform evidence positions, cap-200K effective evidence fidelity equals 0.890241826923077 within numerical tolerance.
Every probability is finite and in [0,1]; every provider cost and expected attempt count is finite and nonnegative.
Stratum weights sum to one and aggregate outputs independently recompute from stratum rows.
K=1 and K=3 retry expectations match the closed-form geometric formulas.
Scaling to 1000 and 1000000 assigned sessions is exact multiplication without materializing one row per task.

Evidence interpolation uses only eligible source-reported anchors or the approved exact digest-pinned Chroma proportion anchors, performs no extrapolation, and marks every unbracketed threshold unidentifiable.
The fixed-seed paired Monte Carlo sentinels bracket their analytic completion and cost-per-success deltas in the declared 95 percent intervals.
Primary fidelity and beta decision boundaries satisfy their defining predicates and bisection bounds independently within the declared 1e-12 tolerance.
An independent validator recomputes trajectory, quality, retry, break-even, scaling, Monte Carlo, and evidence-onset results without importing the simulator.

primaryEvidenceSources.title: Context Rot: How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance
Lost in the Middle official repository

inferenceBoundary: The study estimates consequences of a declared cost ledger and hypothetical quality/retry equations. Its generic grid is sensitivity analysis, and its Chroma, RULER, NoLiMa, and Lost-in-the-Middle values are historical evidence or proxies. None is a GPT-5.6 Pi calibration or a production forecast.
